name: Palo Brunch Veal Saltimbocca with Prosciutto, Sage & Barolo Wine Jus
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse (Brunch)
whyItWorks: Thinly pounded tender veal escalopes wrapped in prosciutto are zero-fiber protein; only the bitter rapini/broccoli rabe side needs swapping.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask to swap the fibrous black-garlic rapini side for creamy risotto or fondant potatoes, and order the Barolo jus on the side.
watchOuts: Fibrous rapini (broccoli rabe) side and black garlic (swap for risotto/potatoes)
